content_html:
An open protocol for the moment a program needs a person.

Agents run continuously. The people who can unblock them do not, and those people are still the ones accountable for the decision. Handoff specifies what happens in between: how a request for a human decision is stated, how it reaches someone, how their answer comes back, and what record survives afterwards.

The claim the whole design is built to support is deliberately narrow:

One human answer, delivered to your agent exactly once, as typed data, authorizing exactly one effect.

Every clause of that is load-bearing:

  • One human answer. A specific person acted, and the record says who. Clearance is asserted by a human, never inferred from a side effect. That distinction is the reason this project exists; the section on prior art below explains where it came from.
  • Exactly once. An answer is consumed when it is used. A stored yes cannot be spent a second time by a retry, a replay, or a duplicate delivery.
  • As typed data. The answer is a value against a declared schema, not free text that a prompt has to interpret. A field a renderer cannot draw is a field a human cannot answer, so unknown field types are rejected rather than degraded into a text box.
  • Authorizing exactly one effect. The answer is bound to the specific thing it was shown against. It does not generalize to the next call, the next run, or a similar-looking request.

What Handoff does not claim

It does not resume your program's execution. There is no stack snapshot, no continuation capture, no reaching into your runtime. Your code asks, waits however it prefers (a blocking call, a webhook, a poll), and receives an answer. What it does with that answer is entirely yours. Any description that implies otherwise is overselling, including any we might write later.

It also does not make a self-hosted deployment good at reaching people. Delivery through email, SMS, or voice depends on sender reputation, aligned DNS records, a reviewed app, and carrier relationships. None of that ships in a container, and this repository will not pretend it does.

Status

Pre-release. The protocol runs; it has not been published, and there is no hosted service running this reference implementation.

A deployment of examples/night-hack/ — the four-hour hackathon build preserved here as prior art, and not this implementation — is running at handoff.omegas.dev with no authentication. That was checked on 2026-07-31: the host answers, served by Fly.io. SECURITY.md holds the detail and puts that hostname out of scope. It is a live hackathon demo, not this project, and not a dead link. (This line previously said flatly that there is no hosted service, full stop, which is the sentence that was wrong.)

Level 1 is 26 conformance cases: C-1 through C-16, plus C-6b and C-18 through C-26. C-17 is the only Level 2 case, and this server deliberately does not implement what it covers — see below. The enumeration is spelled out rather than left as a bare count, because a count does not say which cases, and a Server passing every case but one is not Level 1 compliant. Read docs/review-3.md before relying on any of this — it is the most recent of three independent hostile reviews (docs/hostile-review.md, docs/review-2.md, docs/review-3.md), each of which found defects the one before it had missed. BACKLOG.md states the remaining gaps plainly rather than leaving them to be discovered.

Component State
spec/ — the normative protocol v0.1, frozen. 21 invariants, OpenAPI 3.1, signing test vectors that reproduce.
conformance/ — the suite 26 Level 1 cases + 1 Level 2. Written before the server, and demonstrably red against one that implements nothing.
core/ — the Rust reference implementation handoffd, the target of the Level 1 suite. Level 2 (continuation) is not implemented and is not advertised.
sdk/python — handoff-human 0.2.0. Standard library only.
sdk/ts — @handoffproto/sdk Zero runtime dependencies.
managed/ — the hosted adapter Closed-source, unpublished. Refuses where a dependency does not exist rather than pretending.
ui/responder — a standalone human-facing page Not built. It appears in the layout below as intended; it is absent on disk.

Nothing in this tree has been published. The one exception predates it: handoff-human 0.1.0 is already on PyPI from the hackathon build, under the MIT grant NOTICE relies on. The 0.2.0 in sdk/python is not published, and the crate and npm names are not yet reserved.

This table is the honest state as of the last commit. If it disagrees with something else in this repository, this table is what was checked — and the disagreement is a defect worth reporting, because a status document that is trusted and stale is worse than one nobody reads.

Where the spec lives

spec/ is normative and is the source of truth for every implementation, including ours:

File What it is
spec/handoff-protocol-v0.1.md The normative protocol, using RFC 2119 keywords
spec/openapi.yaml The wire contract, and the source the typed SDKs are generated from
spec/schemas/*.schema.json Request, receipt, policy, and delivery-attempt schemas
spec/signing.md The receipt and callback signature scheme, with test vectors
spec/CHANGELOG.md What changed and when

The spec is versioned independently of the implementations, by tag namespace (spec/v0.1, core/v0.3.1, sdk-py/v0.2.0, and so on). See GOVERNANCE.md for the version policy and for the process a spec change has to go through, which is stricter than the one for code.

Repository layout

core/               Rust workspace. Apache-2.0. Intended for crates.io; not yet published.
  crates/handoff-protocol/        types, state machine, policy evaluation. No I/O.
  crates/handoff-core/            the engine and the port traits a deployment implements
  crates/handoff-store-postgres/  reference store and its own migration set
  crates/handoff-adapters/        delivery channels, feature-gated per channel
  crates/handoff-server/          the reference server. Binary: handoffd
  crates/handoff-conformance/     the suite runner. Takes any base URL.
conformance/        Declarative cases. The governance instrument, not a test helper.
sdk/python/         handoff-human. MIT.
sdk/ts/             @handoffproto/sdk. MIT. Zero runtime dependencies.
ui/responder/       PLANNED, not present. A standalone page for the person answering. Apache-2.0.
examples/           Worked examples, including the original hackathon build.
docs/               Documentation source.

Self-hosting

Self-hosting is the point rather than a concession, so it is worth being precise about what it does and does not get you.

The shape today: point handoffd at a Postgres database, give it a configuration file naming the people it can reach and the channels it may use, and run it. It has no dependency on any hosted service, no phone-home, no licence key, and no disabled feature waiting to be switched on. CONTRIBUTING.md makes a dormant gate in this repository a mergeable-blocking defect rather than a matter of taste.

What a self-hosted deployment genuinely guarantees: correctness of the state machine; exactly-one-effect semantics; waits that survive a process restart; a complete local audit trail; full data export; and no runtime dependency on anyone else being alive, solvent, or interested.

What it structurally cannot guarantee, stated here rather than discovered later:

  • Independent attestation. A receipt signed with a key you control is adequate for internal control and worthless as evidence against you. Only a party who is not the operator can attest to what an operator's system recorded. That is the definition of a third party, not a feature we are withholding.
  • Deliverability. See above. A fresh deployment starts at zero reputation on every channel.
  • Cross-tenant signals. "This number has been paged 400 times today by twelve different senders" is not computable by one deployment that cannot see the others.
  • Retention as a promise. Your audit trail is exactly as durable as your backups. A promise needs a promisor.

Meanwhile you can read the spec and implement it yourself. That is a supported outcome, and the conformance suite exists so you can prove you got it right without asking us.

The open and closed line

Some of the product around Handoff is commercial. The boundary is drawn by a published test rather than by convenience:

Open everything required to define, run, and independently verify a handoff on a single tenant's own machine. Keep closed only what derives its value from a third party operating it: shared infrastructure, cross-tenant knowledge, and promises that outlive the customer's own process.

In practice almost everything is open. The closed surface reduces to a delivery fleet, the cross-tenant view, third-party attestation, and one company's own billing and organization model, none of which is protocol. Three clauses bind the maintainer and are written into GOVERNANCE.md: no crippleware, the receipt verifier is open unconditionally, and export is open. If you think a change violates one, cite the clause in the pull request; it has to be answered in public.

The mechanism that keeps this from becoming a slogan is the conformance suite. A hosted service that cannot pass the open suite has a red build, which turns "we did not quietly fork the core" from an intention into a check anyone can rerun.

Subtree Licence

Apache-2.0 on the spec and the implementation because its §3 grants patent rights expressly and terminates them on patent litigation against the project. MIT on the SDKs because a thin client gets vendored into everything, including projects whose licences make Apache-2.0 awkward, and its patent exposure is nil.

The Python SDK was first published under MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Noureddin Bakir. That grant stands and is not rewritten here. Trademark conditions live in TRADEMARKS.md and never in the licence text.

Contributing

Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. The short version:

  • Sign off your commits (git commit -s). We use the Developer Certificate of Origin. There is no CLA and there will not be one, because the only thing a CLA would buy beyond what Apache-2.0 §5 already grants is the option to close this later.
  • A spec/ change needs a conformance case that fails before it and passes after, or two independent implementations.
  • A core behaviour change without a conformance case is not merged.

Most wanted: delivery adapters, SDK ports to other languages, conformance cases, and corrections to ambiguous spec prose. An ambiguity in a normative document is a real defect.

Security issues go to the private channel in SECURITY.md, never a public issue. Note that in this protocol a request identifier can itself be a capability, so treat one like a credential.

Prior art, and the honesty discipline

Handoff started as a four-hour build at founders.inc Night Hack on 2026-07-24. That build is preserved under examples/night-hack/ with a README describing what it is and, more usefully, what it is not.

It is kept because it is the evidence. It also demonstrated the failure the protocol exists to prevent: before it, "the human is finished" was inferred from a page URL or title changing, which silently misses a wall cleared in place. A person ticks a verification checkbox, nothing about the page identity changes, and the agent waits until its deadline for an obstacle that is already gone. The fix generalizes into the rule stated at the top of this file: a human action is recorded, never detected.

DISCLOSURE.md is that build's honest accounting of what existed beforehand, what was made during the event, and what was measured rather than asserted. It is kept at the root of this repository on purpose. The standard it sets applies to everything here: say what was checked, say how it was checked, and say plainly what was not.

content_html_zh:
一个开放的协议，目前程序需要一个人。

代理持续运行。 能够解锁它们的人却没有解锁，而这些人仍然是对决定负责的人。 交接指定了中间发生的事情：如何陈述对人类决策的请求，如何到达某人，他们的答案如何返回，以及之后保留哪些记录。

整个设计所支持的主张故意狭窄：

一个人工答案，作为键入的数据一次性发送给您的代理，仅授权一种效果。

其中的每个条款都是承载的：

  • 一个人类的答案。 一个特定的人行动了，记录表明是谁。 清除率是由人类断言的，而不是从副作用中推断出来的。 这种区别就是这个项目存在的原因；下面关于现有技术的部分解释了它的来源。
  • 就一次。 答案在使用时就会被消耗。 存储的“是”不能通过重试、重播或重复传递而再次使用。
  • 作为键入的数据。 答案是针对声明的模式的值，而不是提示必须解释的自由文本。 渲染器无法绘制的字段是人类无法回答的字段，因此未知的字段类型将被拒绝，而不是降级为文本框。
  • 只授权一种效果。 答案与它所针对的具体事物有关。 它不会推广到下一次调用、下一次运行或类似的请求。

Handoff 不主张什么

它不会恢复程序的执行。 没有堆栈快照，没有连续捕获，也没有进入运行时。 您的代码会提出请求，按照它喜欢的方式等待（阻塞调用、Webhook、民意调查），然后收到答案。 它对这个答案的作用完全取决于你。 任何暗示其他情况的描述都是过分夸大的，包括我们以后可能写的任何描述。

它也不能使自托管部署擅长接触人们。 通过电子邮件、短信或语音进行的交付取决于发件人信誉、一致的 DNS 记录、经过审核的应用程序以及运营商关系。 这些都不是装在容器中的，这个存储库也不会假装它是装在容器中的。

地位

预发布。 协议运行；它尚未发布，并且没有托管服务运行此参考实现。

example/night-hack/ 的部署（作为现有技术保留在此处的四小时黑客马拉松构建，而不是此实现）正在 handoff.omegas.dev 上运行，无需身份验证。 已于 2026 年 7 月 31 日检查：主持人回答，由 Fly.io 提供服务。 SECURITY.md 保留详细信息并将该主机名置于范围之外。 这是一个现场黑客马拉松演示，不是这个项目，也不是死链接。 （这句话之前断然说没有托管服务，句号，这句话是错误的。）

1 级是 26 个一致性案例：C-1 到 C-16，加上 C-6b 和 C-18 到 C-26。 C-17 是唯一的 2 级案例，该服务器故意不实现它所涵盖的内容 - 见下文。 枚举被拼写出来，而不是留下一个简单的计数，因为计数并没有说明哪些情况，并且服务器通过了所有情况，但其中一个不符合 1 级标准。 在依赖任何一个之前，请阅读 docs/review-3.md — 这是三个独立的敌对评论（docs/hostile-review.md、docs/review-2.md、docs/review-3.md）中最新的一个，每个评论都发现了之前错过的缺陷。 BACKLOG.md 清楚地说明了剩余的差距，而不是让它们被发现。

成分 State
spec/ — 规范协议 v0.1，冻结。 21 个不变量、OpenAPI 3.1、签名可重现的测试向量。
一致性/——套件 26 个 1 级案例 + 1 个 2 级案例。 写在服务器之前，并且对于没有实现任何内容的人来说是明显的红色。
core/ — Rust 参考实现 handoffd，1 级套件的目标。 2 级（延续）未实施且未公布。
sdk/python — 切换人类 0.2.0. 仅标准库。
sdk/ts — @handoffproto/sdk 零运行时依赖性。
Managed/ — 托管适配器 闭源，未发布。 在不存在依赖性的情况下拒绝而不是假装。
ui/responder — 一个独立的面向人的页面 未建成。 它按预期出现在下面的布局中；它在磁盘上不存在。

这棵树中的任何内容都尚未发布。 在此之前有一个例外：handoff- human 0.1.0 已经在 Hackathon 构建中出现在 PyPI 上，并得到了 NOTICE 所依赖的 MIT 资助。 sdk/python 中的 0.2.0 尚未发布，crate 和 npm 名称尚未保留。

该表是截至上次提交的诚实状态。 如果它与此存储库中的其他内容不一致，则检查此表 - 并且这种不一致是值得报告的缺陷，因为受信任且过时的状态文档比无人阅读的状态文档更糟糕。

规范所在的地方

spec/ 是规范性的，是每个实现（包括我们的实现）的事实来源：

File 它是什么
规范/handoff-protocol-v0.1.md 规范协议，使用RFC 2119关键字
规范/openapi.yaml 电汇合同以及生成类型化 SDK 的来源
规范/模式/*.schema.json 请求、接收、策略和交付尝试模式
规范/签名.md 收据和回调签名方案，带有测试向量
规范/CHANGELOG.md 发生了什么变化以及何时发生变化

该规范的版本独立于实现，通过标签命名空间（spec/v0.1、core/v0.3.1、sdk-py/v0.2.0 等）。 请参阅 GOVERNANCE.md 了解版本策略以及规范更改必须经历的流程，这比代码更严格。

  crates/handoff-store-postgres/  reference store and its own migration set
  crates/handoff-adapters/        delivery channels, feature-gated per channel
  crates/handoff-server/          the reference server. Binary: handoffd
  crates/handoff-conformance/     the suite runner. Takes any base URL.

sdk/ts/             @handoffproto/sdk. MIT. Zero runtime dependencies.
ui/responder/       PLANNED, not present. A standalone page for the person answering. Apache-2.0.

docs/               Documentation source.

自托管

自托管是重点而不是让步，因此有必要准确说明它能做什么和不能做什么。

现在的形式是：将 handoffd 指向 Postgres 数据库，为其提供一个配置文件，命名它可以到达的人员以及它可以使用的渠道，然后运行它。 它不依赖于任何托管服务，没有回拨，没有许可证密钥，也没有等待打开的禁用功能。 CONTRIBUTING.md 使该存储库中的休眠门成为可合并阻塞缺陷，而不是品味问题。

自托管部署真正保证的是什么：状态机的正确性；完全单一效果语义；进程重启后仍然存在的等待；完整的本地审计追踪；完整数据导出；并且运行时不依赖于任何其他活着的、有偿付能力或感兴趣的人。

它在结构上不能保证什么，在这里陈述而不是后来发现：

  • 独立认证。 用您控制的密钥签署的收据足以用于内部控制，但作为对您不利的证据毫无价值。 只有非运营商的一方才能证明运营商系统记录的内容。 这是第三方的定义，而不是我们保留的功能。
  • 可交付性。 见上文。 全新部署在每个渠道上均以零信誉开始。
  • 跨租户信号。 “这个号码今天已被 12 个不同的发件人寻呼了 400 次”，无法通过无法看到其他号码的部署来计算。
  • 保留作为承诺。 您的审计跟踪与您的备份一样持久。 承诺需要承诺者。

同时您可以阅读规范并自行实现。 这是一个受支持的结果，并且存在一致性套件，因此您可以证明您的做法是正确的，而无需询问我们。

开线和闭线

一些围绕 Handoff 的产品是商业化的。 边界是通过已发布的测试而不是为了方便而划定的：

打开在单个租户自己的计算机上定义、运行和独立验证切换所需的所有内容。 仅保留从第三方运营中获得价值的部分：共享基础设施、跨租户知识以及比客户自己的流程更长久的承诺。

实际上，几乎一切都是开放的。 封闭的表面简化为交付车队、跨租户视图、第三方证明以及一家公司自己的计费和组织模型，而这些都不是协议。 三个条款绑定维护者并写入 GOVERNANCE.md：无残件、无条件开放收据验证器、开放导出。 如果您认为某项更改违反了规定，请在拉取请求中引用该条款；它必须公开回答。

防止这成为口号的机制是一致性套件。 无法通过开放套件的托管服务具有红色构建，这将“我们没有悄悄分叉核心”从意图转变为任何人都可以重新运行的检查。

贡献

首先阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md。 简短版本：

  • 签署您的提交（git commit -s）。 我们使用开发者原产地证书。 没有 CLA，也不会有 CLA，因为除了 Apache-2.0 §5 已经授予的内容之外，CLA 唯一能购买的是稍后关闭它的选项。
  • 规范/变更需要一个在其之前失败并在其之后通过的一致性案例，或者两个独立的实现。
  • 没有一致性案例的核心行为变更不会被合并。

最需要的是：交付适配器、其他语言的 SDK 端口、一致性案例以及对模糊规范散文的更正。 规范性文件中的含糊之处是一个真正的缺陷。

安全问题会进入 SECURITY.md 中的私人频道，而不是公共问题。 请注意，在此协议中，请求标识符本身可以是一种功能，因此请将其视为凭证。

现有技术和诚实纪律

Handoff 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日在Founders.inc Night Hack 上开始了一个为期四小时的构建。 该构建保存在 Examples/night-hack/ 下，并有一个自述文件描述了它是什么，更有用的是，它不是什么。

它被保留，因为它是证据。 它还证明了该协议存在的缺陷：在此之前，“人类已经完蛋了”是从页面 URL 或标题更改中推断出来的，这会默默地错过清理到位的墙。 一个人勾选了验证复选框，页面身份没有任何变化，并且代理等待已经消失的障碍的截止日期。 该修复概括为该文件顶部所述的规则：记录人类行为，但从未检测到。

DISCLOSURE.md 是构建对之前存在的内容、事件期间所做的内容以及测量而不是断言的内容的诚实记录。 它故意保存在该存储库的根目录中。 它设定的标准适用于这里的一切：说明检查了什么，说明检查方式，并明确说明未检查的内容。
